headline: [[q|Israel began committing genocide.]] Two of the most-read opening sections now say it in Wikipedia’s own voice.
unit: sentences charging Israel with genocide: Jan 2021 · Jul 2023 · now, in the 150 most-read opening sections that existed in 2021 (plus Israel’s denial)
body: Own voice: the articles on Israel and on Benjamin Netanyahu; five others attribute the charge. No sentence in these 150 charges Hamas or Palestinians with genocide.

headline: “Militant” left Hamas’s definition five days after October 7. The hostages are in neither the Hamas nor the Israel opening section.
unit: after October 7, “militant” left Hamas’s definition (12 Oct 2023)
body: Hamas is now [[q|a Sunni Islamist Palestinian nationalist political organisation with a military wing]]; the designation sentence moved from sentence 5 of 20 to 22 of 23.

headline: 1948 got an agent. The Nakba is now [[q|the ethnic cleansing of Palestinian Arabs by Zionists]], in Wikipedia’s own voice.
unit: the Nakba’s first sentence, in Wikipedia’s own voice, since 6 July 2026
body: Three of the four 1948 articles quoted in this report now name the agent (Nakba, 1948 Palestine war, 1948 Arab–Israeli War); the fourth, 1948 Palestinian expulsion and flight, removed it from its first sentence.

headline: Israel’s occupation, and its illegality, is now stated as fact far more often.
unit: of occupation charges against Israel stated in Wikipedia’s own voice (16 of 35 → 44 of 55)
body: Many of the new ones are history and events of 2024 to 2026; the same happened to occupation charged to Russia in Crimea and Turkey in northern Cyprus (25% to 74%).

headline: Canvassing is documented on both sides. The rewriting began in the war’s first weeks, before the pro-Palestinian Discord channel.
unit: pace of new critical wording on topic pages against other pages in the 16 weeks after 7 Oct 2023 (0.5× before the war; 2.0× while the Discord channel was active)
body: ArbCom found pro-Israel email canvassing (January 2024 motions) and sanctioned editors for acting on off-wiki canvassing from a pro-Palestinian Discord channel (December 2024).[[verify|ArbCom items read from search snippets only; check primary pages (ORGS.md section 5)]] Our footprint tests found no campaign signature and could only have seen very large effects.

headline: The pages readers reach first changed; the obscure ones did not.
unit: of Top-importance Israel, Palestine and Jewish-topic articles gained critical vocabulary in their opening paragraph since July 2023 (121 sampled); other conflict regions 4.4%; gap +5.9 points, range +0.9 to +11.2
body: Mid importance: 1.5% against none of the 362 comparison articles sampled; across all 49,000 articles the gap is 0.4 points, within the margin of error. Articles on Judaism did not move.
